title: On-call cockpit: task provisioning and safe-preview for admin utilities
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an on-call cockpit that provisions parameterized admin tasks (from runbook snippets) with a safe-preview dry-run mode, RBAC gating, and a staged canary rollout for automated repairs. The feature ties Console UX flows to the runbooks-as-tasks runtime so operators can preview effects, view required permissions, and execute with telemetry and rollback hooks. It should support both Hosted and Dedicated deployments and integrate with the existing ops-telemetry pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Operators can select a templated admin task in Console and open a preview modal showing the exact commands and affected resources (dry-run).
Provisioned tasks honor role-based permission checks and provide explicit escalation steps when additional rights are required.
Dry-run outputs consume the runtime's KV-cache and batching simulation so estimated token costs and latency are displayed.
Canary execution supports N-percent execution and automatic fallback to a safe-noop variant on regressions.
Execution emits telemetry events that appear in the Ops dashboard with trace IDs and runbook version.

next_steps: Resolve infra quota blocking ticket ENG-582308 with infra team
Finalize canary policy config and expose percent selector in Console

notes: Trade-offs: Dry-run uses simulation not full execution; some side-effects (third-party webhooks) can't be perfectly simulated and require additional guardrails.
Security: We will require a security review before enabling canary in any customer-dedicated tenant.
Telemetry: Use existing 'ops.run' event schema; add 'preview' flag and runbook_version metadata.
